317-1475-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

4419-4694-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

293-728-5220-5716.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1
Repeat.

3532-5078-6747-7864.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
3532-5078-6747-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4865-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4091-4188-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
4091-4188-7791.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

206-339-677-997.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1753-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1753-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1753-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1806-2060-6774-6798-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4365-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1170-1329-3499-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3581-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

586-2921-5258-5618-6556.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

856-2267-4779-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

777-1117-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4200-5686-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
4200-5686-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3668.notablePrerequisites:
Flesh Duplicate is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3668.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3668.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

2034-3374-3979.notablePrerequisites: Squad Captain does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-3374-3979.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Squad Captain persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squad Captain, adding {C}{C}.
When Squad Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with no -1/-1 counter on it due to its ability.
Repeat.

4050-4385-4893.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

868-1170-2493-4036.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Seething Song from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Desperate Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2744-5189.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2744-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

880-3470-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
